remarks: Pristine townhouse nestled in a small, well-maintained complex in Norwalk. This home features its own private entrance and peaceful wooded views in the rear, offering exceptional privacy while you relax on one of your two private decks. It showcases a kitchen with newer appliances, seamlessly flowing into a bright and inviting living room with hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and sliding doors leading to the main deck-perfect for indoor-outdoor living. Upstairs, both bedrooms feature vaulted ceilings and beautiful natural light. Each bedroom offers its own full bathroom, and one includes access to a second private deck. A convenient powder room completes the main level. The spacious, finished lower level has been carpeted and includes a laundry area, mechanical room, and abundant storage space ideal for a home office, gym, or recreation room. Two reserved parking spaces plus ample visitor parking add everyday convenience. Enjoy low-maintenance living with access to the community pool. Close to i95 and Merritt Parkway.
